label: Volga famine
title: Famine on the Volga
blurb: The young League of Red Cross Societies asks for 180 million francs for famine relief in Russia, close to a billion in 2025 francs and its first great test.

label: Kantō earthquake
title: Great Kantō earthquake, Japan
blurb: Tokyo and Yokohama burn after the quake. The 277-million-franc appeal, almost 1.9 billion in 2025 francs, is bigger in real terms than any appeal launched since 1945.

label: Second World War
title: The Second World War
blurb: Wartime relief actions are recorded under their 1939 start dates: 815 million francs, about 6.5 billion in 2025 francs, still the biggest year in this record. The empty years 1940–44 are an artefact of that bookkeeping.

label: Ethiopia famine
title: Famine in Ethiopia
blurb: Drought appeals for Ethiopia and its neighbours drive the mid-1980s bump, the decade when African food crises became the system's main work.

label: Armenia earthquake
title: Spitak earthquake, Armenia
blurb: A 95-million-franc appeal for the earthquake in Soviet Armenia, one of the last great relief operations of the Cold War, recorded under the USSR.

label: Somalia · Bosnia
title: After the Wall: Somalia, Bosnia, the former USSR
blurb: State collapse replaces superpower order: famine in Somalia, war in Bosnia and a 136-million-franc appeal for former Yugoslavia keep asks high through 1991–93.

label: Rwanda
title: Genocide in Rwanda
blurb: Appeals for Rwanda and the refugee exodus into Goma. 1994 is also the first year GO records what donors actually gave; everything earlier shows only the ask.

label: Hurricane Mitch
title: Hurricane Mitch, Central America
blurb: Mitch stalls over Honduras and Nicaragua and kills over 11,000 people. 1998 is also a rare year when overall funding nearly matched the ask.

label: İzmit · Kosovo
title: İzmit earthquake and Kosovo
blurb: A 65-million-franc appeal for the Marmara earthquake in Türkiye lands in the same year as the Kosovo displacement crisis, pushing asks past 300 million.

label: Indian Ocean tsunami
title: Indian Ocean tsunami
blurb: A 671-million-franc appeal, the Movement's largest of the modern era, and donors nearly covered it. 2004 remains the high-water mark of public generosity.

label: Kashmir earthquake
title: Kashmir earthquake, Pakistan
blurb: Months after the tsunami, a 168-million-franc appeal for the Pakistan earthquake tests whether donor generosity can strike twice in one year.

label: Sichuan · Nargis
title: Sichuan earthquake and Cyclone Nargis
blurb: Two catastrophes weeks apart, a 153-million-franc appeal for China and a major operation in Myanmar, make 2008 the busiest year of its decade.

label: Haiti earthquake
title: Haiti earthquake
blurb: A 274-million-franc appeal for Port-au-Prince. 2010 is the rare year in the whole record when money given outran money asked.

label: Syria
title: Syria: a decade-long emergency begins
blurb: A 209-million-franc complex-emergency appeal opens what becomes a permanent line in the ledger: Syria appears among the largest asks for the next decade.

label: Ebola
title: Ebola in West Africa
blurb: Parallel appeals for Sierra Leone, Liberia and Guinea mark the first time an epidemic, not an earthquake or a storm, drives the year's funding.

label: Rohingya exodus
title: Rohingya exodus to Bangladesh
blurb: A 198-million-franc appeal for population movement into Cox's Bazar, the largest displacement appeal the Movement had launched to that point.

label: COVID-19
title: COVID-19 pandemic
blurb: A 670-million-franc global appeal, the only one in this record addressed to everywhere at once. Barely two-thirds of the year's asks were met.

label: Ukraine
title: Ukraine and impacted countries
blurb: At 800 million francs, the largest single appeal ever recorded in GO. Yet in 2025 francs it is still well under half the size of the 1923 Kantō appeal.

label: Türkiye–Syria quakes
title: Türkiye–Syria earthquakes
blurb: Twin quakes kill nearly 60,000 people. Asks approach a billion francs for the year, but barely two-fifths arrive, one of the widest funding gaps in the record.
